text:
maria_partner_eng: Heads-up: partner engineering request from OCI team — they want a validated Terraform module for our private deployment on Ampere (arm64) bare-metal.

aj_devrel: Nice. Do we have an existing refarch we can adapt or is this a full new module?

leo_infra: We have a dedicated terraform kit for AWS/GCP, but OCI has a different provider and some networking quirks (VCN shapes, public/private subnets). Could reuse patterns but need provider blocks + module wrapper.

sarah_sales: Partner asked for a "drop-in" example they can use in the marketplace listing + a small quickstart for SI partners.

maria_partner_eng: Goals: 1) minimal working module for private deploy (VPC/VNIC, security lists, KMS integration) 2) reference arch diagram + example inputs 3) CI validation in our repo (tf init/plan + fmt check) 4) marketplace packaging notes.

aj_devrel: Suggest the PR contains:
- /examples/oci/ampere-baremetal/
- README with inputs/outputs and expected costs
- github actions workflow: terraform fmt/validate/plan

leo_infra: Also need a compatibility matrix: terraform-provider-oci version, OCI SDK, and note for arm64-compatible images (our container images must have arm64 builds).

maria_partner_eng: Can someone draft a lightweight checklist? I can own the partner comms. Who picks up module authoring?

aj_devrel: I can scaffold the module and example. ETA EOD Thursday.

leo_infra: I'll add infra tests and CI. I can add a small GH action to run tfplan against a free OCI tenancy (we can use partner's test account) or use mocked plan with local backend.

sarah_sales: Also confirm marketplace listing metadata requirements. I'll pull the docs and ping the OCI partner rep.

deploy-bot: deployment_check: new repo create detected: redwood/marketplace-oci-ampere-tf (draft).

maria_partner_eng: Nice. Next steps:
1) @aj_devrel create PR with module + example
2) @leo_infra add CI + compatibility matrix
3) @sarah_sales gather marketplace metadata and partner test tenancy
4) I'll schedule a 30m sync with OCI rep Friday 10am PT

aj_devrel: quick Q on encryption — do we recommend customer-managed keys only (KMS/HSM) or allow service-managed for ease?

leo_infra: Default to KMS optional. In README show how to toggle. Marketplaces often want simple defaults.

maria_partner_eng: Agreed. Keep defaults simple, but add a 'secure_by_default' example.

sarah_sales: I'll confirm marketplace submission process and any packaging constraints (tarball vs OCI listing). Might need a separate artifacts bucket.

aj_devrel: I'll include a sample terraform snippet in README:
```
module "redwood_private" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/marketplace-oci-ampere-tf//modules/private"
  tenancy_ocid = var.tenancy_ocid
  compartment_id = var.compartment_id
  ocpus = 32
  use_kms = true
}
```

leo_infra: FYI: need to test that our images run under arm64 qemu locally. I'll add a small matrix job for linux/arm64 and amd64 builds.

maria_partner_eng: Perfect. I'll send calendar invite for Friday 10am PT and cc OCI rep. Thanks all :thumbsup:

aj_devrel: Will open PR shortly.

sarah_sales: I'll DM OCI rep now.

maria_partner_eng: Closing loop — post PR link here when ready.
